caseNameFull: In the Matter of DISCIPLINE OF Carla Ruth McBEATH.

opinions.text:
In the Matter of DISCIPLINE OF Carla Ruth McBEATH.

Carla Ruth McBeath, of Fort Lee, New Jersey, is suspended from the practice of law in this Court and a rule will issue, returnable within 40 days, requiring her to show cause why she should not be disbarred from the practice of law in this Court.
